beat_player.text: gg {player} ur army just became a bonfire lol. the insult list grows tonight tho
told u ur walls were paper {player}... {troop_count} troops and still ran like a goat. ez

running {player}? smart. u still owe me the fight i was promised. wont forget the cart u dropped

u ran {player}? ok u got sense. next time bring ur army instead of ur excuses :)

hey {player} tell {rival} i still have their insult saved in my notes. the fields around vezhdrak say hi
{rival} owes me 3 insults {player}?? no, ur the one who keeps losing, cmon
bet {rival} cried when they lost to me and {player} wasnt even there. ur welcome for the entertainment

whisper_challenge.text: {player} meet me at {town} road, bring whatever army u have left after {village}. ill burn it again for fun
{player} got a spare afternoon? theres a field near {village} i want to smoke. loser buys ale
{player} i know ur hiding. {town} at dawn, no excuses, no ledger tricks this time. i'll be the one counting
meet at {village} {player}? dont bring ur usual 50 spears lol, i want a real fight for once
{player} the scorch marks from {village} are art, and ur next. come get ur name in the ashes

encounter_threatened.text: {player} u want {gold} gold? lol nah, my men are hungrier than ur threats. try again with a better accent
surrender? {player} ser ive been burned out of better villages than this. ill take my chances, u can keep the fear
ok {player} u want {gold} from me? ill pay half and we both pretend it was a loan lol :)
pay {gold} to u?? {player} the only thing im paying is the scorched fields bill, cope harder
{player} ur threat is loud but ur army is quiet. ill keep my gold, u keep ur pride, deal?

encounter_greeting.text: {player} ser, {persona} of {my_faction} here. ur banner looks like it needs ashes. get out of the way
{player} look who finally came out. {persona} of {my_faction}, pleasure, dont take it personally when i win
{player}! {persona} from {my_faction} says hi. ur still my favourite loser :) lets not make it a fight today
oh {player}, ur on my road again. {my_faction} sends its regards, and so do all my torches
{persona} of {my_faction} at ur service {player}. got any gold on u or should i just take ur horses

ambient_brag.text: {fief} is a wreck of ashes thanks to me. {troop_count} men, {gold} gold, and the fields still smell like victory lol
anyone else see the scorch art outside {fief}? {troop_count} troops built that. i call it a masterpiece xD
{gold} gold in my pocket and {troop_count} hungry boys at my side. come try me, ill wait by {fief}
{fief} is mine until someone brave enough shows up. {troop_count} spears say no complaints, ez

player_big_defeat.text: {player} lost {troop_count} men and still has the nerve to talk. lol the road is littered with ur pride
{player} ur army just evaporated and ur still breathing. shame, i wanted to do that myself
{troop_count} men gone for {player}? brutal. not my doing this time, i swear, the ashes are someone elses
ur {troop_count} lads didnt deserve that {player}. dont let it break u, i still want my rematch
rip {player}s {troop_count} troops. ez, cope, and maybe next time dont bring a cart full of excuses
